        - heading "Break-Even Analysis" [level=1]
        - paragraph: "Objective: Find the break-even quantity and total-cost-revenue equality."
        - text: "Level: Intermediate-Advanced Room: Applied Modelling Lab Medium: Graphing / Spreadsheet / CAS Time: 6-10 min"
      - complementary:
        - text: Lesson code 603-BEA
        - paragraph: Topics Break-even point, Cost & Revenue, Contribution margin
        - img "Cost and revenue icon"
      - navigation:
        - button "Interact"
        - button "Learn"
        - button "Worked Example"
        - button "Formula"
        - button "Practice"
      - main:
        - heading "1 Observe & Manipulate" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Drag the quantity or adjust the controls. Watch the lines and values update.
        - button "Reset All":
          - img
          - text: Reset All
        - heading "Cost and Revenue vs Quantity" [level=3]
        - img "Break-even cost and revenue graph": 0 50 100 150 200 250 2,25,000 1,80,000 1,35,000 90,000 45,000 0 Total Revenue (TR) Total Cost (TC) Fixed Cost (FC) Break-even point (100, Rs 90,000)
        - text: Quantity (units) 100 0
        - slider "Quantity slider": "100"
        - text: "250 TR (Rs) 90,000 TC (Rs) 90,000 Profit / (Loss) (Rs) 0 Contribution Margin (Rs) 50,000 CM / unit (Rs) 500 Break-even: TR = TC at Q = 100 units and Rs 90,000"
        - heading "2 Manipulate the model" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Adjust the assumptions and see immediate results.
        - text: Fixed cost (Rs) 0
        - slider "Fixed cost (Rs) slider": "50000"
        - text: 200,000
        - spinbutton "Fixed cost (Rs)": "50000"
        - text: Variable cost per unit (Rs) 0
        - slider "Variable cost per unit (Rs) slider": "400"
        - text: 2,000
        - spinbutton "Variable cost per unit (Rs)": "400"
        - text: Selling price per unit (Rs) 1
        - slider "Selling price per unit (Rs) slider": "901"
        - text: 5,000
        - spinbutton "Selling price per unit (Rs)": "900"
        - text: CM per unit (Rs) 500 CM ratio 55.56% BEP (units) 100 BEP (Rs) 90,000 Margin of Safety (Rs) 0 (0.0%) CM = SP - VC = 900 - 400 = Rs 500 | CM ratio = CM / SP | MOS = TR - Break-even sales
      - complementary:
        - article:
          - heading "3 Notice the pattern" [level=2]
          - paragraph: ✓At break-even, the Revenue line intersects the Total Cost line.
          - paragraph: "✓Left of the intersection: TC > TR (loss). Right of it: TR > TC (profit)."
          - paragraph: ✓Increasing fixed cost shifts the break-even right.
          - paragraph: ✓Higher selling price or lower variable cost shifts it left.
        - article:
          - heading "4 Understand the rule" [level=2]
          - paragraph: Key Rule (Break-Even) TR = TC SP x Q = FC + VC x Q
          - strong:
            - text: Q
            - subscript: BE
            - text: = FC / (SP - VC)
          - paragraph:
            - text: "Definitions FC: Total fixed cost VC: Variable cost per unit SP: Selling price per unit Q"
            - subscript: BE
            - text: ": Break-even quantity CM = SP - VC"
          - complementary: Common misconception Confusing profit = 0 with cost = 0. At break-even, both cost and revenue are positive and equal.
        - article:
          - heading "Worked Example" [level=2]
          - paragraph: A product has FC = Rs 50,000, VC = Rs 400 per unit and SP = Rs 900 per unit.
          - paragraph:
            - text: Solution CM per unit = Rs 500 Q
            - subscript: BE
            - text: = 50,000 / 500 = 100 units Break-even sales = 900 x 100 = Rs 90,000
          - complementary:
            - text: Matches the interactive model
            - img
